_notes: formEndpoint: set to a form-submission URL (e.g. a Formspree/Basin/Getform endpoint or your own API). It is a public URL, not a secret. Leave empty until configured; the form then says it is not connected and never reports success. officeHours: leave empty to hide; set e.g. "Mon–Fri, 9:00 AM–6:00 PM" when confirmed. siteUrl: set to the public address (e.g. https://opspilot.ph, no trailing slash) once the domain is connected; the build then adds canonical/og:url tags and sitemap.xml.
_notes2: Optional buttons appear in the contact section only when set: bookingUrl (Cal.com/Calendly link), messengerUrl (e.g. https://m.me/yourpage), viberNumber / whatsappNumber (digits with country code, e.g. 639193185860), photo (path to an image placed in public/, e.g. jig.jpg).
_notes3: images: optional photo/AI image per industry card on the home page, e.g. "service-contractors": "img/contractors.jpg" (file placed in public/img/, 1280x560 recommended). Empty = the built-in illustration is used. See IMAGE-PROMPTS.md.
_notes4: showRepresentativeName: false (default) keeps any personal name off the site. To show a named contact, set contactPerson (e.g. "Full Name") and showRepresentativeName to true; the name then appears on the About card and the Contact page.
